SheetMemory

SheetMemory is a local-first structured memory plugin for OpenClaw.

Short description:
- Captures durable facts, rules, preferences, plans, and corrections as typed records.
- Uses deterministic retrieval with field filters instead of vector similarity.
- Uses a rule-based Perceptor before any optional LLM classification.
- Stores records in SQLite with time-based decay and archival.

What it is:
- A structured memory layer for OpenClaw.
- A rule-first ingestion pipeline for agent memory.
- A local-first alternative to embedding-heavy memory stacks.

What it is not:
- Not a vector database.
- Not an embedding-based semantic retrieval system.
- Not a cloud memory service.

Primary value:
- Deterministic retrieval for rules, facts, and preferences.
- Auditable stored memory records.
- Local deployment without GPU requirements.
- Better handling of high-signal user constraints than tool-call-only memory.

Key concepts:
- Perceptor
- Structured memory protocol
- Deterministic retrieval
- SQLite storage
- Weibull decay
- Optional local-model classification

Recommended pages:
- README.md
- PROTOCOL.md

Suggested summary:
SheetMemory is a local-first OpenClaw memory plugin that captures structured records through rule-first ingestion and retrieves them deterministically without embeddings.
